name: figma-extract-all
description: Extract everything from Figma, rebuild web pages as Figma layers, check a design rubric, and let Claude or other LLMs work in Figma through a local MCP bridge.

scripts.release: npm run build && node verify.js && git add -A && git commit -m 'Release v19.1.0' && git tag v19.1.0 && git push origin master --tags
scripts.test: npm run build && node verify.js && cd bridge && node test/plugin.test.mjs && node test/bridge.test.mjs

author: Extract All Contributors
